search_searxng_query: search a SearXNG instance for a given query and return sorted results as SearchResult objects
search_searxng_with_language: search a SearXNG instance filtering results by language and safe search settings
search_searxng_with_time_range: search a SearXNG instance filtering results by a specific date time range
search_searxng_with_categories: search a SearXNG instance within specific categories and return top results
search_searxng_with_filter: search a SearXNG instance and filter results by a list of allowed domains
